title: Elijah at Mount Carmel
summary: The Lord alone is God, and worship belongs to Him. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read 1 Kings 18:20-39 and look for how this passage teaches: The Lord alone is God, and worship belongs to Him.

tell_it: Elijah challenged the prophets of Baal. God answered by fire, showing the people that the Lord is God.
understand_it: The Lord alone is God, and worship belongs to Him. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Elijah at Mount Carmel reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Worship matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Elijah at Mount Carmel shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: The Lord alone is God, and worship belongs to Him.
teen_explanation: Elijah at Mount Carmel gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that the Lord alone is God, and worship belongs to Him. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: The Lord alone is God, and worship belongs to Him.
Faith means trusting God enough to respond.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when worship is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Who answered by fire?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: The Lord. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that the Lord alone is God, and worship belongs to Him.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember 1 Kings 18:39 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Elijah at Mount Carmel?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: True God Choice
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: The Lord alone is God, and worship belongs to Him.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Elijah at Mount Carmel. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
